recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-26965 unless PA later chooses to revisit element placement, summary behavior, or whether the Extension Pack extension context should mention Appointment despite the native element.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification PA issue originally asking whether the request-replaces standard extension should apply to Appointment; the final resolution chose a native Appointment.replaces 0..* Reference(Appointment) property with cancellationReason details available on the referenced Appointment.
initial_application: Jira-tagged commit 58aa3c2fb9 added Appointment.replaces to source/appointment/structuredefinition-Appointment.xml, and Jira-tagged commit 91957e4ef6 moved it into request workflow ordering after PA's May 2021 agenda requested reconfirming the element order.
additional_context: Appointment is active in source/fhir.ini. FHIR-26526 was the parent request-extension cleanup that spawned this Appointment-specific follow-up. Current source maps Appointment.replaces to Request.replaces, documents Appointment-specific Request mapping differences, and the Extension Pack request-replaces contexts do not include Appointment, consistent with the native-element resolution.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The current Appointment StructureDefinition already defines Appointment.replaces as 0..* Reference(Appointment), includes the requested cancellationReason guidance, and maps the element to Request.replaces.
